Docket 1.3.138

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Audit your own large site in hours, not a day.* Some sites ask crawlers, in robots.txt, to wait several
  seconds between pages. Docket waits, so a large shop asking for 4 seconds could take longer than the day
  an audit may run. If the site is yours, tick "This is my site: skip the crawl delay" (or use
  --skip-crawl-delay) and Docket reads it at its normal pace. Every page your robots.txt blocks still stays
  unread, and the report says the delay was skipped.

99 checks across 13 areas.
